Changed file: [direct_url.py](~/muse_suggest/packaging__e80f70f8b1__blind/repo/src/packaging/direct_url.py:292)

Why: the `urlsplit` check only compared the scheme, so it accepted `file:foo`, `file:/single-slash`, and `file:relative/path`, which the original `startswith("file://")` check (and the error message, which requires `file://`) reject — `urlsplit` can't even distinguish `file:/x` from `file:///x`.
